title: Glowing red apple
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='36' fill='#ff2200' opacity='0.12'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#ff3300' opacity='0.15'/>
  
  <!-- Apple body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='25' fill='#e01010'/>
  
  <!-- Apple body shading - left highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='54' rx='18' ry='18' fill='#ff3333' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Apple body shading - top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='48' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#ff5555' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bright highlight spot -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='47' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ff8888' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ffbbbb' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom shading -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='68' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#b00808' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Left edge highlight ring -->
  <path d='M 26 52 Q 24 58 27 66' stroke='#ff4444' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' opacity='0.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Apple dimple at top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#c00808'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='#a00606'/>
  
  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d='M 50 34 Q 51 26 54 21' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 50 34 Q 51 26 54 21' stroke='#A0704C' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Leaf -->
  <path d='M 53 25 Q 60 20 65 23 Q 62 28 55 27 Z' fill='#3fa83f'/>
  <path d='M 54 25 Q 59 22 63 23.5 Q 61 26 55 26 Z' fill='#5ccc5c' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M 53 25 Q 59 24 64 23' stroke='#2d8a2d' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Glow rim on apple edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='25' fill='none' stroke='#ff6600' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
